caveats.en: Display-only context — never scored, never a call. A chain state is a WATCH item; it never gates, sizes, ranks, or escalates anything (masterplan §4).
caveats.zh: 仅供展示的上下文——从不计入评分，从不作为交易指令。

caveats.en: Per-hop base rates are UNTESTED in W1 (base_rates=null) — the episode miner and the forward ledger fill them in W3. A propagating chain is not a forecast.
caveats.zh: W1中各跳的基础发生率尚未检验（base_rates=null）。

caveats.en: Per-name blast radius (`blast`) is a WATCH-grade membership screen with a field receipt. Counts always include the unevaluable (missing-field) bucket: a missing field is neither safe nor unsafe. Only ARMED chains resolve; dormant chains carry blast={}.
caveats.zh: 个股层面的传导范围（blast）是带字段凭证的观察级成员筛选。
